parsed.notes:
WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR and MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS supply required skills; PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS supplies optional skills. Technologies appearing only in responsibilities, company descriptions, or benefits are excluded.
Group 1 contains the mapped alternatives remaining from the distributed-training framework list; Axolotl is unmapped. DeepSpeed leaves the group because the separate training-library qualification asks for it independently.
Pre-training alternatives have no remaining multi-member mapped group: model training is independently required, while the other distinct training methods lack taxonomy entries.
Transformers is read literally as the training library named in the qualification, using the available transformers taxonomy entry.
The open-source-llms mapping is flagged because contributing to open-source LLM training tools does not necessarily establish experience with open-source models themselves.
Unmapped entries include technical methods explicitly requested in qualifications; research venues, publication credentials, and domain knowledge are not treated as skills.
